what_happened: Consumer-shape ForwardSlackWitnessed witness (stepOr, bot, plateau C) plus general climbing-path companion compiled first try via lake env lean through the build guard; draft saved at probe-draft/consumer-shape-witness.lean

Task description suggests either probe outcome 'decides the gate'; measured: a positive instance at phi=bot has a singleton cell and decides only the existential crux (satisfiable at SOME reached state), not the universal discharge. Report records this bound on reach explicitly.

Premise re-validation: all five file/line citations in the description confirmed unchanged against the live tree; research had already refuted the xState-transcription suggestion and narrowed 'either outcome decides the gate' to existence evidence, both carried into the plan.

Wired-probe total measured 61 (60 WIRED + 1 WIRED_REPO), not the 59 the archived 929 plan closed at; plan states the criterion as after = before + 1 rather than a literal figure because concurrent agents may move it again.

Plan Phase 1 verification greps the promoted probe for 'sorry' requiring 0 hits, while the same plan's verdict wording uses 'sorryAx-free theorem'; the docstring verdict was reworded to 'a theorem resting on no placeholder axiom' so the grep gate stays at 0.

Launching the probe guard as 'nohup setsid cmd &' made $! the short-lived setsid parent, so the kill -0 waiter resolved immediately while the guard kept running; fell back to a bounded wait on the guard's own verdict line in its log. Also the harness moved a 570s foreground wait to background after 180s, so waits were re-issued in sub-180s bounded chunks.
Research had already compiled the probe draft, so implementation was a verbatim promotion plus wiring: about 20 minutes against a 2.5 hour estimate, with the promoted file compiling first try.
